_doc: Every job this system runs, in one place (doc/jobs.md). role: node = every node; exec = nodes with an exec node; operator = the machine whose private/config.json sets "operator_jobs": true. source: repo = the unit files live in this directory and scripts/reconcile_units.py installs, refreshes and enables them (as root, through the nado-restart bridge after every update); install.sh = per-machine units that install.sh generates with that machine's settings, never overwritten from here, listed only so /status can report them. Work that only reads the chain runs INSIDE the node instead (the DEX price sampler, the daily stats) and needs no unit.
